# yaml-test-suite ledger — the expected outcome of THIS parser on every case of
# github.com/yaml/yaml-test-suite (`data` branch), asserted by src/suite_test.zig.
#
# The suite itself is NOT vendored here (fetch it and point ZIG_LIBS_YAML_SUITE
# at it, or the harness skips loudly). This file is the committed claim about it.
#
#   event  <id>            parses, and the dumped event stream equals test.event
#                          byte for byte
#   reject <id>            the suite marks this input invalid (an `error` file);
#                          our parser must return an error for it
#   fail   <id>  <reason>  KNOWN-FAIL — the case does NOT reach the outcome above.
#                          A reason is mandatory and must be specific.
#
# The assertion runs in BOTH directions: a listed pass that fails is red, and a
# known-fail that starts passing is red too. The id set must match the suite's
# exactly, so a case appearing or disappearing upstream is also red — that is
# what keeps this file from quietly drifting into a lie.
#
# 402 cases, 94 of them must-reject. Currently 402/402: there are no `fail`
# lines. Do not add one without a specific reason.
